newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Anglo leaps as H1 earnings beat forecast.
newsitem.headline: Anglo leaps as H1 earnings beat forecast.

text.p: Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd shares jumped 150 cents on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange on Tuesday following the release of better-than-expected first half results.
"We have seen good earnings in Anglo American. That followed through to De Beers which added a rand since," dealers said.
Dealers said the results were "outstanding" and Anglo's announcement that it saw similar headline earnings in the second half were encouraging.

Shares briefly touched 257.50 rand -- a 150 cent increase -- after the release at 1305 GMT. They had since slipped back a touch to settle 125 cents higher at 257.25 rand after 89,400 shares worth nearly 24 million rand traded.
Anglo posted earnings up to 1,273 cents for the six months ended September 30 from 837 cents previously and a dividend up to 160.0 cents from 130 cents.

Analysts polled by Reuters ranged Anglo's interim earnings per share between 1,035.0 cents and 1,130.0 cents with consensus at 1,070 cents. They said that a dividend would likely stand between 150.0 cents per share and 160.0 cents with consensus at 153.0 cents.
